@Cardinal.SharplyLT.exists_isCardinalFiltered_set.{u_1} : ∀ {κ₁ κ₂ : Cardinal.{u_1}} [inst : Fact κ₁.IsRegular]
  [inst_1 : Fact κ₂.IsRegular],
  @Cardinal.SharplyLT.{u_1} κ₁ κ₂ inst inst_1 →
    ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst_2 : PartialOrder.{u_1} X]
      [@CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.{u_1, u_1, u_1} X
          (@Preorder.smallCategory.{u_1} X (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} X inst_2)) κ₁ inst]
      (A : Set.{u_1} X),
      HasCardinalLT.{u_1, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X A) κ₂ →
        ∃ B,
          And (@LE.le.{u_1} (Set.{u_1} X) (@Set.instLE.{u_1} X) A B)
            (And
              (@CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X B)
                (@Preorder.smallCategory.{u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X B)
                  (@Subtype.preorder.{u_1} X (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} X inst_2) fun x =>
                    @Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} X (Set.{u_1} X) (@Set.instMembership.{u_1} X) B x))
                κ₁ inst)
              (HasCardinalLT.{u_1, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X B) κ₂))

@Cardinal.SharplyLT.tfae.{u_1} : ∀ {κ₁ κ₂ : Cardinal.{u_1}} [inst : Fact κ₁.IsRegular] [inst_1 : Fact κ₂.IsRegular],
  @LT.lt.{u_1 + 1} Cardinal.{u_1}
      (@Preorder.toLT.{u_1 + 1} Cardinal.{u_1}
        (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1 + 1} Cardinal.{u_1} Cardinal.partialOrder.{u_1}))
      κ₁ κ₂ →
    (@List.cons.{0} Prop (@Cardinal.SharplyLT.{u_1} κ₁ κ₂ inst inst_1)
        (@List.cons.{0} Prop
          (@CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory.{u_1, u_1, u_1 + 1}
            (@CategoryTheory.CardinalDirectedPoset.{u_1} κ₁ inst)
            (@CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.category.{u_1, u_1 + 1} PartOrdEmb.{u_1}
              PartOrdEmb.instCategory.{u_1} (@PartOrdEmb.isCardinalFiltered.{u_1} κ₁ inst))
            κ₂ inst_1)
          (@List.cons.{0} Prop
            (∀ (C : Type (u_1 + 1)) [inst_2 : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_1 + 1} C]
              [@CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory.{u_1, u_1, u_1 + 1} C inst_2 κ₁ inst],
              @CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory.{u_1, u_1, u_1 + 1} C inst_2 κ₂ inst_1)
            (@List.cons.{0} Prop
              (∀ (X : Type u_1),
                HasCardinalLT.{u_1, u_1} X κ₂ →
                  ∃ A,
                    And
                      (HasCardinalLT.{u_1, u_1}
                        (@Set.Elem.{u_1} (CategoryTheory.CardinalDirectedPoset.SetCardinalLT.{u_1} κ₁ X) A) κ₂)
                      (@IsCofinal.{u_1} (CategoryTheory.CardinalDirectedPoset.SetCardinalLT.{u_1} κ₁ X)
                        (@Subtype.instLE.{u_1} (Set.{u_1} X) (@Set.instLE.{u_1} X) fun S =>
                          HasCardinalLT.{u_1, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X S) κ₁)
                        A))
              (@List.cons.{0} Prop
                (∀ ⦃X : Type u_1⦄ [inst_2 : PartialOrder.{u_1} X]
                  [@CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.{u_1, u_1, u_1} X
                      (@Preorder.smallCategory.{u_1} X (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} X inst_2)) κ₁ inst]
                  (A : Set.{u_1} X),
                  HasCardinalLT.{u_1, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X A) κ₂ →
                    ∃ B,
                      And (@LE.le.{u_1} (Set.{u_1} X) (@Set.instLE.{u_1} X) A B)
                        (And
                          (@CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X B)
                            (@Preorder.smallCategory.{u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X B)
                              (@Subtype.preorder.{u_1} X (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} X inst_2) fun x =>
                                @Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} X (Set.{u_1} X) (@Set.instMembership.{u_1} X) B x))
                            κ₁ inst)
                          (HasCardinalLT.{u_1, u_1} (@Set.Elem.{u_1} X B) κ₂)))
                (@List.nil.{0} Prop)))))).TFAE

@Cardinal.SharplyLT.exists_cofinal.{u_1} : ∀ {κ₁ κ₂ : Cardinal.{u_1}} [inst : Fact κ₁.IsRegular]

              A)
